description: This file defines the FileCookieJar class, a PHP class used for persisting cookies in a JSON file within the GuzzleHttp library. It manages loading and saving cookies, optionally including session cookies, and handles file I/O operations with error handling.

classes.name: FileCookieJar
classes.description: A class for persisting cookies in a JSON formatted file, extending the CookieJar class to add file storage capabilities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the FileCookieJar, optionally loading cookies from the specified file.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Saves the cookies to the file upon object destruction.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Serializes cookies into JSON and writes them to a file, with error handling.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads cookies from a JSON file, reconstructing cookie objects and handling errors.
